sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Many of the quests in Escape from Tarkov require items to be found in raid.

An item is marked as "Item found in raid" if:
- It was found in a raid and the raid was ended with the "Survived" extraction status.
  - Items brought into a raid by PMC's automatically lose the found in raid condition.
  - Items that were extracted from a raid which was ended with the "Left the Action", "Killed in Action (KIA)", "Missing in Action (MIA)" or "Run Through" extraction states do not have the found in raid condition.
    - To avoid the "Run Through" extraction status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid by killing or looting, or be in the raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting.
- It was crafted in the Hideout.
- It was obtained as a quest reward.

Items that were found in raid and get delivered to the stash via the BTR Driver's item extraction service or when using transits stay marked as such.
